model.dbt_pnc.src_mfp_contracts.name: src_mfp_contracts
model.dbt_pnc.src_mfp_contracts.description: Cleaned contract versions: renamed columns, typed, technical records removed.
model.dbt_pnc.src_mfp_contracts.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

select
    contract_id,
    partner_id,
    product_code,
    valid_from,
    nullif(valid_to, date '9999-12-31')          as valid_to,
    case status_code
        when 'A' then 'active'
        when 'C' then 'cancelled'
        when 'S' then 'suspended'
        else 'unknown'
    end                                          as contract_status,
    annual_premium                               as annual_premium_chf,
    load_ts                                      as _loaded_at
from {{ source('raw_mfp', 'contracts') }}
where contract_id is not null

model.dbt_pnc.int_mfp_contracts.name: int_mfp_contracts
model.dbt_pnc.int_mfp_contracts.description: Contract versions enriched with partner attributes. Core entity of the portfolio pipeline.
model.dbt_pnc.int_mfp_contracts.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

with contracts as (
    select * from {{ ref('src_mfp_contracts') }}
),

partners as (
    select * from {{ ref('src_mfp_partners') }}
)

select
    c.contract_id,
    c.partner_id,
    c.product_code,
    c.contract_status,
    c.valid_from,
    c.valid_to,
    c.annual_premium_chf,
    p.partner_type,
    p.age_years,
    p.canton,
    p.language_code
from contracts c
left join partners p using (partner_id)

model.dbt_pnc.int_mfp_coverages.name: int_mfp_coverages
model.dbt_pnc.int_mfp_coverages.description: Coverage lines joined to their tariff, incrementally loaded on valid_from.
model.dbt_pnc.int_mfp_coverages.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='incremental', unique_key='coverage_id') }}

with coverages as (
    select * from {{ ref('src_mfp_coverages') }}
    {% if is_incremental() %}
    where valid_from >= (select max(valid_from) from {{ this }})
    {% endif %}
),

tariffs as (
    select * from {{ ref('src_mfp_tariffs') }}
)

select
    cov.coverage_id,
    cov.contract_id,
    cov.risk_code,
    cov.sum_insured_chf,
    cov.deductible_chf,
    cov.tariff_code,
    cov.valid_from,
    t.region_factor,
    t.base_rate
from coverages cov
left join tariffs t
    on cov.tariff_code = t.tariff_code
   and cov.risk_code  = t.risk_code
model.dbt_pnc.int_mfp_coverages.compiled_code:
with coverages as (
    select * from `pnc-analytics-prd`.mfp_source.src_mfp_coverages
),
tariffs as (
    select * from `pnc-analytics-prd`.mfp_source.src_mfp_tariffs
)
select

    cov.contract_id,
    cov.risk_code,
    cov.sum_insured_chf,
    cov.deductible_chf,
    cov.tariff_code,
    cov.valid_from,
    t.region_factor,
    t.base_rate
from coverages cov
left join tariffs t

model.dbt_pnc.int_mfp_premium_calc.name: int_mfp_premium_calc
model.dbt_pnc.int_mfp_premium_calc.description: Technical premium per coverage (ephemeral: inlined into downstream models).
model.dbt_pnc.int_mfp_premium_calc.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='ephemeral') }}

select
    contract_id,
    coverage_id,
    risk_code,
    sum_insured_chf,
    base_rate,
    region_factor,
    round(sum_insured_chf / 1000 * base_rate * region_factor, 2) as technical_premium_chf,
    annual_premium_chf
from {{ ref('int_mfp_contract_coverage') }}
model.dbt_pnc.int_mfp_premium_calc.compiled_code:

model.dbt_pnc.out_mfp_portfolio_daily.name: out_mfp_portfolio_daily
model.dbt_pnc.out_mfp_portfolio_daily.description: Daily portfolio snapshot per product, canton and risk. Feeds the portfolio dashboard.
model.dbt_pnc.out_mfp_portfolio_daily.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='incremental', unique_key='snapshot_date') }}

select
    current_date()                        as snapshot_date,
    cc.product_code,
    cc.canton,
    cc.risk_code,
    count(distinct cc.contract_id)        as contract_count,
    count(cc.coverage_id)                 as coverage_count,
    sum(cc.sum_insured_chf)               as sum_insured_chf,
    sum(pc.technical_premium_chf)         as technical_premium_chf,
    sum(cc.annual_premium_chf)            as written_premium_chf
from {{ ref('int_mfp_contract_coverage') }} cc
left join {{ ref('int_mfp_premium_calc') }} pc using (coverage_id)
where cc.contract_status = 'active'
group by 1, 2, 3, 4
model.dbt_pnc.out_mfp_portfolio_daily.compiled_code:
select
    current_date()                        as snapshot_date,
    cc.product_code,
    cc.canton,
    cc.risk_code,
    count(distinct cc.contract_id)        as contract_count,
    count(cc.coverage_id)                 as coverage_count,
    sum(cc.sum_insured_chf)               as sum_insured_chf,
    sum(pc.technical_premium_chf)         as technical_premium_chf,
    sum(cc.annual_premium_chf)            as written_premium_chf
from `pnc-analytics-prd`.mfp_intermediate.int_mfp_contract_coverage cc
left join `pnc-analytics-prd`.mfp_intermediate.int_mfp_premium_calc pc using (coverage_id)
where cc.contract_status = 'active'
group by 1, 2, 3, 4

model.dbt_pnc.out_mfp_premium_report.name: out_mfp_premium_report
model.dbt_pnc.out_mfp_premium_report.description: Monthly premium reconciliation: technical vs. written premium per product.
model.dbt_pnc.out_mfp_premium_report.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

select
    date_trunc(current_date(), month)                       as reporting_month,
    c.product_code,
    count(distinct pc.contract_id)                          as contract_count,
    sum(pc.technical_premium_chf)                           as technical_premium_chf,
    sum(pc.annual_premium_chf)                              as annual_premium_chf,
    safe_divide(sum(pc.technical_premium_chf),
                sum(pc.annual_premium_chf))                 as premium_adequacy_ratio
from {{ ref('int_mfp_premium_calc') }} pc
join {{ ref('int_mfp_contracts') }} c using (contract_id)
group by 1, 2
model.dbt_pnc.out_mfp_premium_report.compiled_code:
select
    date_trunc(current_date(), month)                       as reporting_month,
    c.product_code,
    count(distinct pc.contract_id)                          as contract_count,
    sum(pc.technical_premium_chf)                           as technical_premium_chf,
    sum(pc.annual_premium_chf)                              as annual_premium_chf,
    safe_divide(sum(pc.technical_premium_chf),
                sum(pc.annual_premium_chf))                 as premium_adequacy_ratio
from `pnc-analytics-prd`.mfp_intermediate.int_mfp_premium_calc pc
join `pnc-analytics-prd`.mfp_intermediate.int_mfp_contracts c using (contract_id)
group by 1, 2

reporting_month.description: First day of the reporting month.

model.dbt_pnc.out_mfp_customer_360.name: out_mfp_customer_360
model.dbt_pnc.out_mfp_customer_360.description: One row per partner with portfolio aggregates for the CRM front-end.
model.dbt_pnc.out_mfp_customer_360.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

select
    p.partner_id,
    p.partner_type,
    p.age_years,
    p.canton,
    p.language_code,
    count(c.contract_id)                                as contract_count,
    sum(c.annual_premium_chf)                           as total_premium_chf,
    min(c.valid_from)                                   as customer_since,
    array_agg(distinct c.product_code ignore nulls)     as product_codes
from {{ ref('src_mfp_partners') }} p
left join {{ ref('int_mfp_contracts') }} c using (partner_id)
group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
